summary: Eagle Point Income Company Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose management’s unaudited estimates of net asset value per share and net investment income for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The filing provides NAV per share range ($12.48-$12.58), NII estimate ($0.35-$0.39/share), and realized gains/(losses) estimate (($0.68)-($0.64)/share). This is a routine NAV update for a closed-end investment company, not a special situation. It does not involve any transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, or other special-situations event. The registrant is the issuer filing a current report on Form 8-K. No deal terms, advisors, or structural changes are mentioned. There are no risk-arb or regulatory clock considerations.
